dex.text: A length of blackened keel timber with something warm still ticking inside it. It turns up on the shingle at Bounty Bay after dark, glowing like a coal you were told to put out.
dex.fact: The mutineers stripped the Bounty and burned her in Bounty Bay on 23 January 1790, so that no passing ship would spot her and wonder. Pieces of the wreck have been found in the shallows ever since.

dex.text: The ship herself, remembered. Flames the colour of old rum climb a mast that is not there, and the sea in the bay goes quiet to listen. It has never once been seen to hurry.
dex.fact: Pitcairn was a good hiding place partly because the Admiralty charts of the day put it well away from its true position. The Bounty's mutineers arrived there in January 1790, and nobody came looking in the right place for years.
